# Spitter: a squat fungus toad 0.7 m long, olive green with a khaki mushroom cap on its back, two pale
# bulging eyes and a wide dark mouth; it spits acid. Origin: on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.2784 0.4157 0.1843 --no-slot
material new Belly --base-color 0.4118 0.5137 0.3647 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.6392 0.6078 0.4235 --no-slot
material new Gill --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new Mouth --base-color 0.0980 0.1294 0.0980 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.6392 0.6784 0.5451 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3 --location 0 0 0.24
scale 1.15 1.05 0.78
apply --scale
material assign Body
add mesh cone --name Cap --vertices 7 --radius1 0.34 --radius2 0.08 --depth 0.22 --location 0 0.12 0.56
material assign Cap
add mesh cylinder --name Gill --vertices 7 --radius 0.24 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0.12 0.43
material assign Gill
add mesh cube --name Mouth --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.300 0.170
scale 0.340 0.100 0.080
apply --scale
material assign Mouth
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 1 --location -0.130 -0.200 0.420
scale 0.110 0.110 0.110
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 1 --location 0.130 -0.200 0.420
scale 0.110 0.110 0.110
apply --scale
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name FootR --size 1 --location -0.240 -0.180 0.050
scale 0.140 0.180 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Belly
add mesh cube --name FootL --size 1 --location 0.240 -0.180 0.050
scale 0.140 0.180 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Belly
select all
shade flat
export spitter.glb
